title: How he came to play so many instruments
summary: He lists the instruments he took up, and returns to how Johnny Dodds urged him to play clarinet and saxophone.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: How did you happen to play so many instruments?
Well, after, um, from the piano, you know. I like the guitar. First the big violin. Violin, my first instrument.
Then ghetto. Madeline. Bass. Then, uh, I take up the trombone. The trumpet from, uh, my paris. And it, and I record. Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm . Mm-hmm .
Just like yourself. What about clarinet and saxophone? How'd you learn that?

Now, when we go over to Los Angeles, the fellas always liked to play piano. That's how Joey and all them got all their touches on their trumpets. In my style, they liked to play piano. They said, you know something? You ought to be playing a clarinet and saxophone, like Johnny Dot would tell me. Johnny would always tell me, you ought to be playing this clarinet. I used to play clarinet parts on my violin. Then Johnny would play straight. Just like little George Lewis, the same way. Take a little George Lewis. Yeah, the cousin was telling us to build this color. Thank you.
